// CASE shorthand_const_min expect=fire
export async function shorthandConstMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const concurrency = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}

// CASE key_from_const_min expect=fire
export async function keyFromConstMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(1, n);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency: width });
}

// CASE local_options_from_const_min expect=fire
export async function localOptionsFromConstMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const width = Math.min(1, n);
	const options = { concurrency: width };
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}

// CASE limit_shorthand_const_min expect=fire
export async function limitShorthandConstMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const limit = Math.min(n, 1);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { limit });
}

// CASE local_options_inline_min expect=fire
export async function localOptionsInlineMin(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const options = { concurrency: Math.min(1, n) };
	await mapLimit(items, op, options);
}

// CASE shorthand_const_one expect=fire
export async function shorthandConstOne(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>) {
	const concurrency = 1;
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}

// CASE shorthand_const_min_four expect=pass
export async function shorthandConstMinFour(items: string[], op: (s: string) => Promise<void>, n: number) {
	const concurrency = Math.min(4, n);
	await mapLimit(items, op, { concurrency });
}

declare function mapLimit<T>(...args: unknown[]): Promise<void>;
